title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1 +VERANDE NE RRUGEN DRITAN HOXHA
description_sq:
Shitet apartament i tiopologjise 2+1 ne rrugen kryesore Dritan Hoxha.
Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne sallon ndenje dhe kuzhine, dy dhoma gjumi dhe nje tualet.
Ndodhet ne katin e pare banim te nje ndertimi buze rruge kryesore. Apartamenti eshte i pershtatshem per banim ose per zyre/klinike duke qene qe ka orientim nga rruga kryesore e cila ben te mundur nje akses te lehte. Eshte pozicionuar ngjitur me stacionin e autobuzit dhe lidhje direkte per qender, autostraden Tirane-Durres dhe Unazen e Madhe. Gjithashtu apartamenti ka dhe nje verande reth 50m2 te orientuar nga rruga kryesore. Pallati disponon ashensor por ndalon nga kati i trete e lart.
Me certifikate pronesie.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1 + VERANDA ON DRITAN HOXHA STREET
description_en: 2+1 type apartment for sale on the main Dritan Hoxha street. The apartment is organized in living room and kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom. It is located on the first residential floor of a building near the main road. The apartment is suitable for living or for an office/clinic, since it faces the main road, which allows easy access. It is positioned next to the bus station and direct connection to the center, the Tirana-Durres highway and the Great Ring Road. The apartment also has a veranda of about 50m2 facing the main street. The building has an elevator, but it stops from the third floor and above. With certificates of ownership. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
